SCE.S:68A054: This is the residual thought in me. I saw afar, saw all, saw the past. Now I leave this world.
SCE.S:68A120: The underfolk descend from star-born beings of old. Deep below, they can still feel the stars.
SCE.S:68A1EC: Built when humans and underfolk still met. Now they deal only with the Psychic Society.
SCE.S:68A2B8: Carries "seeds" from the mine to the hospital via this tunnel. They bring "change" to many. One is inside her.
SCE.S:68A384: This is the residual thought in me. I guard the passage. I can see it follows a ley line, a path of energy.
SCE.S:68A450: This is the residual thought in me. We found this passage by a vortex of energy. "They" live here too.
SCE.S:68A51C: Those above have lost their hearts. A sudden "change" without heart destroys all.
SCE.S:68A5E8: The underfolk stopped dying and halted their bodies' change. They wait for humankind to evolve.
SCE.S:68A6B4: Residual thought in me: the tunnels bend space, making far places near.
